answer: An hostile operator running 50 aliases as a result needs 195 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in voyage, expire in lotus, and jetty lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2371 identities would post 4116 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
